import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length3_87/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length3_87/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length3_87/training_2.csv", index_col=0)

# Operation 1: JOIN Source3_87_2 and Source3_87_0 on Country = Country Name
# Rename Source3_87_0 'Country Name' to 'Country' to join easily
source0_renamed = source0.rename(columns={"Country Name": "Country"})

# Perform inner join on 'Country'
joined = pd.merge(source2, source0_renamed, on="Country", how="inner")

# Operation 2: group by Source3_87_2.Rank and count occurrences of Rank
# Since Rank is unique in source2, count will be 1 for each Rank
grouped = joined.groupby("Rank").size().reset_index(name="0")

# Ensure columns have correct types as per target schema
grouped["Rank"] = grouped["Rank"].astype(int)
grouped["0"] = grouped["0"].astype(int)

# Save the final target table
grouped.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_87/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
